extracted.name: Homemade Condensed Milk
extracted.description: I've been using this recipe for years; I just wish I had kept track of how much money I've saved by not buying all those little cans!
instruction_lines: Pour boiling water into blender container. Add margarine and sugar. Blend until combined. Add the dry milk powder 1 cup at a time, blending after each addition. Store in refrigerator and use where a recipe calls for sweetened condensed milk, 1 1/3 cups equals one 14 ounce can.
